headline: JSW Steel Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - JSW Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Order ofHon ble National Company Law Tribunal sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation of Piombino Steel Limited with JSW Steel Limited and theirrespective shareholders…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger - JSW Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Order ofHon ble National Company Law Tribunal sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation of Piombino Steel Limited with JSW Steel Limited and theirrespective shareholders under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013
